decisions.statement: simctl push routes by the Simulator Target Bundle key inside the payload.
The payload crosses to the host base64-encoded rather than as literal JSON.
The decoded payload lands at /var/tmp/ops-sim-push-tap.apns on the host.
The deep-link route rides outside `aps` at the payload's top level.
A cold push exits with status 3 when the app is found still running.

definition: the shell that pushes an APNs payload to a booted simulator
